description.en-US: Choose whether Amadeus joins AUIP applications from conversation. Creating, opening and manually using apps stays available.
description.zh-CN: 选择 Amadeus 是否从对话中参与 AUIP 应用。创建、打开和手动使用应用始终可用。

title.zh-CN: 允许 Amadeus 与应用交互

description.en-US: When off, ordinary chat makes no AUIP model calls and carries no app prompts, and Amadeus stops taking turns, acting or commenting in apps. Open apps return to watching; an action already sent keeps its receipt. Saved across restarts.
description.zh-CN: 关闭后，普通聊天不再调用 AUIP 模型、也不附带应用提示词，Amadeus 不再在应用中轮流操作、行动或解说。已打开的应用回到观看模式；已发出的动作保留回执。跨重启保存。
